comparison.objective: Assemble four cylindrical cells between holder halves in a jig; candidate adjusts and locks an already-assembled gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires repeated polarity-aware close-clearance insertion and final holder alignment, rather than coupled screw/nut adjustment with reaction counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Checks holder placement, two/four seated cells, top-holder alignment, release, and loss; candidate checks 90° accuracy, locking, retained cycling, drift, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot-related assembly, but cell insertion and stack assembly do not test preserving a calibrated stop during locknut tightening.
